name: M3_PMS170MI_CrtPlannedMO
description: Create planned manufacturing order proposals either as simulated or real records in material planning. The operation creates a proposal to manufacture a specific product in a selected facility and warehouse, for a given quantity and planning date/time. Proposals can be linked to an order type, product structure or process, schedule, configuration, project, and external references, or created as copies of existing proposals. On success, M3 assigns a unique proposal number and subnumber, returned in the response, which identify the proposal for later retrieval, update, release, or deletion.

inputParameters.name: FACI
inputParameters.description: Facility where the manufacturing order proposal is created.

inputParameters.name: WHLO
inputParameters.description: Warehouse associated with the manufacturing order proposal.

inputParameters.name: PRNO
inputParameters.description: Product number to be manufactured in the planned order.

inputParameters.name: PPQT
inputParameters.description: Planned manufacturing quantity for the order in the item's unit of measure.

inputParameters.name: PLDT
inputParameters.description: Date when the manufacturing order proposal is planned to affect material requirements.

inputParameters.name: PLHM
inputParameters.description: Time of day when the proposal is planned to affect material requirements.

inputParameters.name: PSTS
inputParameters.description: Status to assign to the planned manufacturing order proposal.

inputParameters.name: SIMD
inputParameters.description: Simulation identity used when creating simulated manufacturing order proposals.

inputParameters.name: CONO
inputParameters.description: Company number for which the planned manufacturing order proposal is created.

inputParameters.name: STRT
inputParameters.description: Product structure type used to derive components and routing for the product.

inputParameters.name: ORTY
inputParameters.description: Manufacturing order type controlling how the proposal is processed.

inputParameters.name: RORN
inputParameters.description: Reference order number that initiates or is linked to this manufacturing order proposal.

inputParameters.name: RORL
inputParameters.description: Line number on the reference order connected to this proposal.

inputParameters.name: RORX
inputParameters.description: Line suffix on the reference order connected to this proposal.

inputParameters.name: RORC
inputParameters.description: Order category of the reference order, indicating its origin such as customer or distribution order.

inputParameters.name: PROJ
inputParameters.description: Project number to which the manufacturing order proposal is linked.

inputParameters.name: ELNO
inputParameters.description: Project element within the project that this manufacturing order proposal relates to.

inputParameters.name: SCHN
inputParameters.description: Schedule number used to group and sequence the proposal in production planning.

inputParameters.name: AOID
inputParameters.description: Identifier of an alternate routing to use instead of the standard routing for this proposal.

inputParameters.name: CFXX
inputParameters.description: Previous configuration number from which the current configuration is derived.

inputParameters.name: ECVS
inputParameters.description: Simulation round identifying a specific configuration simulation used for this proposal.

inputParameters.name: PLPN
inputParameters.description: Planned order number identifying an existing proposal, for example when copying or referencing a proposal.

inputParameters.name: CPLP
inputParameters.description: Indicator that the new proposal should be copied from an existing planned manufacturing order.

inputParameters.name: CFIN
inputParameters.description: Configuration number identifying the configured product variant for this proposal.

inputParameters.name: MFPC
inputParameters.description: Process identifier specifying which product structure to use for manufacturing.

inputParameters.name: PCCO
inputParameters.description: Process code defining the manufacturing order category, such as discrete, standard, process, or pack order.

inputParameters.name: EXRN
inputParameters.description: External reference number used to link the proposal to an external system record.

inputParameters.name: EXD2
inputParameters.description: Free-text description for the external reference linked to this proposal.

outputParameters.name: PLPN
outputParameters.description: Planned order number assigned to the created manufacturing order proposal.

outputParameters.name: PLPS
outputParameters.description: Subnumber that further identifies the planned manufacturing order proposal.
